extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: lunar lander (two-stage moon landing module), approx. 9 m across the landing legs, 6.9 m high
extras.notes: front faces -Y (windows, hatch, porch and ladder); 4 landing legs (lunar-lander_leg_*) are separate objects with origin on the upper hinge (fold up by rotating about their local horizontal axis); descent engine glow and beacon are emissive; gold foil descent stage with real inset seams; no text, no flags, no agency logos

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
